mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_article (user_id, title, body, category_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{body}, #{categoryId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.body, a.user_id, u.user_name, a.category_id, c.category_name, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_user u ON a.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{articleId};
mapper.delete: delete from blog_article where id = #{articleId} and user_id = #{userId}
